detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Show your support for the development of Cloudheim with a bundle of exclusive cosmetics and our sincere thanks! The Supporter Pack is a completely optional way to help our small team keep building new features, events, and content throughout Early Access, and look awesome while you do it.

Leap into Cloudheim with four exclusive characters:

  • Brooks

  • Jarl Erland

  • Emma

  • Sylf

Emotes:

  • Jellycow Express

  • Catch a Ride

  • Galloping Greeble

  • Ninja Rush

  • Sign UwU

  • Runari Stride

  • Gnasher Strut

  • Sign Broken Brooks

Character Styles:

  • Add an arcane twist to your roster with Bifröst styles for 26 characters, giving each one a shimmering, otherworldly look pulled straight from the cosmic bridge.

Thank you for your support. It directly helps us develop new content and features during Early Access.

- Noodle Cat Games
